hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: web leads land in a shared inbox that nobody owns after hours.
target_state_control: Assignment SLA with queue ownership and alerts (SLA-04A, RT-F01)

hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: leads are assigned round-robin without regard to workload.
consequence: Some RMs cannot follow up; others are idle.
target_state_control: Hard capacity limit and workload balancing (CAP-06, RT-L02)

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: the referring branch's RM receives leads located in another region.
target_state_control: Territory resolution on SGC 2021 codes (TER-01, RT-P02)

hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: agriculture and commercial-real-estate prospects go to generalist RMs.
target_state_control: Mandatory and preferred specialist rules (SPC-01, SPC-02)

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: the same business arrives from a campaign and a branch and two RMs call it.
target_state_control: Tiered duplicate rules and merge with attribution preserved (DUP-01..DUP-08)

hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: first contact is not time-stamped, so delays are invisible.
target_state_control: First-contact SLA with warning and breach events (SLA-06A..D)

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: a lead stays with an RM on leave for weeks.
target_state_control: Automatic reassignment on acknowledgement breach and unavailability (SLA-05, CAP-08)

hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: nobody knows whether marketing, the branch or the RM owns follow-up.
target_state_control: Every SLA names a responsible role and two escalation levels (SLA catalog)

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: leads without location or size are assigned anyway.
target_state_control: Channel required fields and a validation gate (RT-E01, SLA-02)

hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: one overloaded status field mixes lead, assignment and SLA states.
target_state_control: Separate lead, assignment, activity, SLA and opportunity statuses with a transition table

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: managers move leads without recording why.
target_state_control: Override rule requiring reason and actor role (RT-O01)

problem_title: Leads closed without a clear disposition
hypothetical_scenario: Illustrative control gap: leads are closed with free-text notes only.
consequence: Cannot learn why leads are lost.
target_state_control: Mandatory disposition catalog on every terminal status

hypothetical_scenario: Hypothetical current-state scenario: attribution is overwritten when leads are merged.
target_state_control: Source touches preserved through merges; KPI catalog by channel
